title: Adjunction morphism is compatible with base change
statement: Let k be a separably closed field [def-pc-separably-closed], let X be a smooth projective curve over k with a k-rational point σ [def-pc-smooth-projective-curve] [def-pc-rational-point], let T and T' be k-schemes, let i : T' ⟶ T be a morphism, and let ℒ ∈ F(T) be an object of the Picard subfunctor [def-pc-f-subfunctor]. Thus its derived direct image is isomorphic to an invertible module placed in degree zero, in the sense of [def-pc-invertible-in-degree-zero]. Write i' : X_{T'} ⟶ X_T for the base change of i [def-pc-base-change]. Then the pullback along i' of the adjunction morphism f_T^* f_{T,*} ℒ ⟶ ℒ is isomorphic, as an arrow, to the adjunction morphism f_{T'}^* f_{T',*}(i'^*ℒ) ⟶ i'^*ℒ.
